bias.zh: 偏空 · 重新跌破 200 日均线

read.en: Rockwell Automation slipped 0.4% on Oct 19 to $424.47, trading between $423.64 and $431.71. It is just below the rising 200-day average ($425.9) and the falling 5-day ($425.7), and below the falling 30-day ($430.2), 10-day ($432.2) and 100-day ($448.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($451.00), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 10月19日下跌 0.4%，收于 $424.47，盘中区间 $423.64–431.71。股价略低于上行的 200 日均线（$425.9）和下行的 5 日均线（$425.7），并位于下行的 30 日（$430.2）、10 日（$432.2）和 100 日均线（$448.0）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$451.00），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The 200-day average reclaimed on Oct 16 was lost again on the close. Resistance is $425.7–425.9 (5 and 200-day averages), then $430–432 (30 and 10-day averages, Oct 19 high) and $448–451 (100-day average, SAR). Support is $419–421.5 (May 19 low, Oct 16 low), then $412.7 (Oct 15 low) and $406.9 (Sep 17 low). A close below $412.7 would open $406.9.
